title: A customer discount applies after the tier price
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts', 'See Financial Data', 'Customers — View', 'Customers — Create & Edit', 'Work Orders — Order Parts' and 'Work Order Lines — Create & Edit'.
  • Have a new category for this test, category A, priced by a new matrix for this test, matrix A, with one cost range ($0.00 and up) whose Default rule is Markup % 35.
  • Have a new tier for this test, tier A, with a name no other tier uses, whose column in matrix A is Markup % 20.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, put on tier A for work orders in Edit Customer.
  • Make sure customer A has a 5% discount in Fees & Discounts (for example a military discount), set before work order 1 was made.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, made after customer A's tier was set, with one labor line (line 1), with no labor amount on line 1.
  • Use a desktop browser window at least 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so every column of the page shows.
custom_steps:
1. Open work order 1.
  2. Click Add Part under line 1.
  3. Type a description in Description (for example Test part).
  4. Type 1 in Qty.
  5. Pick category A in Category.
  6. Type 100.00 in Cost.
  7. Click Save.
  8. Point at the part's sell price.
  9. Click the Stats tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1 opens on its Lines tab.

Step 2:

  • A new part row opens under line 1 with Part number, Description, Qty, Category, Cost and Sell price boxes and Save and Cancel.

Step 3:

  • Description holds the typed text.

Step 4:

  • Qty holds 1.

Step 5:

  • Category shows category A.

Step 6:

  • Cost holds 100.00 as typed.

Step 7:

  • The part reads $120.00 ($100.00 × 1.20), with no discount in the line price.

Step 8:

  • The price details show sell price $120.00 and tier A's 20% markup rule.

Step 9:

  • Stats show the 5% discount of $6.00 ($120.00 × 0.05 = $6.00) taken at the end: $120.00 − $6.00 = $114.00 before tax.
